q_results.reconciliation: The L11/L13 point crossing is close to the earlier L9/L11 estimate 0.4206, but the interval remains broad and one quarter of bootstrap trajectories have multiple crossings. This is consistent finite-crossing evidence, not a precision p_c estimate.

The point crossing moves upward from the earlier L9/L11 estimate 0.4686, but 26.7% of bootstrap trajectories contain no crossing, 17.0% contain multiple crossings, and the p=0.49 size trend is unresolved. The automatic finite label does not pass the registered topology/sign promotion gate.
L11/L13 has no point crossing and reverses the earlier five-crossing L9/L11 topology, but the high-p sign is not resolved, so q=0.95 is not ceiling-compatible.

convergence_boundary.interpretation: L13 fixed-point convergence is substantially below L11 and is below 3% throughout q=0.90 and q=0.95. Finite-size topology therefore remains a result for the registered truncated decoder, not evidence of an asymptotic phase boundary.

promotion_decision.reason: q=0.90 lacks stable crossing topology, q=0.95 lacks a resolved high-p sign, and L13 BP convergence is nearly absent in the decisive cells.
